verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are documented as isolated, programmatically created execution environments that developers use to run agent or untrusted code. That makes them a developer building block, not a product capability for setting up autonomous background automations. The evidence shows no scheduling, triggers, recurring runs or automation configuration. The 'autonomous agents' marketing line and the community-built GitHub Actions runners describe things users build on top of sandboxes, not a first-party automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
